name: Lord Windgrace
title: Protector of Urborg
summary: An ancient protector who surrendered his life to close Urborg's temporal rift.
biography: Lord Windgrace ruled as a guardian of Urborg and was wary of the destructive effects of artifice and the interventions of outsiders. The Rathi Overlay left his homeland scarred with transplanted structures and a dangerous rift.
When Teferi and his companions sought a way to heal the plane, Windgrace's suspicion made cooperation difficult. He nevertheless came to recognize the scale of the crisis.
Windgrace gave his life sealing Urborg's rift, leaving an enduring spiritual connection to the land he had defended.

featuredCard.significance: A Commander 2018 depiction of the historical guardian of Urborg.

source.title: Wizards of the Coast — Planeswalker's Guide to Dominaria
